department: Department of Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences

deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall 2027 is January 8th, 2027

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not part of the application.
gre_general.quote: We do not require GRE scores as part of our application package.

supervisor.value: The page does not require agreement with a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students receive tuition waivers and a competitive stipend for their whole course of study.
funding.quote: Full-time Ph.D. students receive tuition waivers and a competitive stipend for the duration of their course of study.

entry_route.value: PhD students take 60 or 90 credit hours depending on whether they enter with a relevant master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. students must complete either 60 or 90 credit hours, depending on whether or not they are entering the program with a relevant master’s degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Environmental sciences are covered by this same department.
